phase_0.constitution_check: Baseline prerequisites passed; final constitution validation runs after Specify/Plan and Implement when route/UI scope is confirmed.

key_outcomes: Accepted GET /api/tasks/[id]/evidence as the generic task-scoped v1 route.
Accepted a light task evidence envelope with schema_version, task, pilot_eligibility, identity, packet_artifacts, smoke, current_stage, warnings, deferrals, and source_map sections.
Accepted 200 responses with explicit not_eligible or incomplete states for non-pilot, local-only, and partial-proof tasks.

Accepted auth/scope/error matrix after consensus: 401 unauthenticated, 400 malformed workspace scope, existing 403 forbidden explicit workspace scope, masked 404 task_not_found for missing or cross-workspace task, and 200 domain states for incomplete evidence.
Accepted artifact references and safe metadata only; artifact content remains behind existing artifact read routes.

consensus.item: API error behavior for missing task, unauthorized workspace scope, artifact store disabled, and incomplete evidence
consensus.outcome: Accepted masked 404 task_not_found for missing/cross-workspace task, 401/400/403 for auth/scope failures, 200 incomplete/not_eligible domain states, and section-level artifact warning when aggregate evidence can still render.

key_outcomes: Accepted a compact read-only Evidence section inside the existing task detail Details tab.
Accepted rendering the section for every opened task with density based on evidence state.
Accepted explicit loading, empty/no-evidence, route error, missing-proof, stale/unavailable, and deferred states.
Accepted labelled section semantics with accessible names, non-color-only status text, and polite async announcements unless Plan later chooses full tab semantics.
Confirmed no global Evidence page, diagnostics dashboard, or evidence-producing controls.
Accepted compact snake_case v1 evidence states and warning reason codes for oversized or malformed evidence.

Accepted source hierarchy: current task/activity rows for live stage and identity; packet artifacts for packet existence and snapshot references; current artifact/review/governance/GitHub sync rows for section evidence; smoke checklist only through stored references or static UAT links.
Accepted a lighter read-only task evidence helper rather than calling buildPilotReviewPacket() as a packet generation path on GET.
Accepted safe metadata-only rendering for unsafe/non-current artifacts after security consensus.
Accepted no runtime Markdown parsing of docs/qa/pilot-smoke-checklist.md.

consensus.item: Rendering redacted, quarantined, superseded, oversized, malformed, unsafe, or secret-bearing artifact evidence
consensus.outcome: Accepted safe metadata/status/source-map rendering only; redacted previews only when already stored as safe derivatives; quarantined/unsafe/malformed/oversized evidence exposes no raw content, preview, storage URI, object path, signed URL, parser details, or actor identity; superseded remains trace-only; no quarantine override or mutation controls.

key_outcomes: Accepted retained issue #50 / PR #51 plus SPEC-009D packet/source-map and smoke-checklist evidence as canonical UAT proof.
Accepted disposable SPEC-009E task rows only as browser-journey carriers when no live retained task row exists.
Accepted cleaned disposable rows as archived/UAT proof with cleanup rationale, never as current active Mission Control state.
Accepted backup/export, before/after counts, owner/timestamp, retained GitHub trail, and checklist evidence for any fixture cleanup.
Accepted docs/qa/pilot-smoke-checklist.md as canonical SPEC-009E UAT ledger.

consensus.item: UAT retained evidence source and cleaned disposable row representation
consensus.outcome: Accepted retained issue #50 / PR #51 plus SPEC-009D packet/source-map and smoke-checklist evidence as canonical proof; disposable SPEC-009E rows may be seeded only as UI carriers; cleaned rows render as archived/UAT proof with cleanup rationale and never as current active Mission Control state.
